note: What a client sends to mark a point on the map for the others.

fields.name: x
fields.note: Where on the map, along one ground axis.

fields.name: z
fields.note: Where on the map, along the other ground axis.

fields.name: target
fields.note: A network object the mark is on, or zero where it is on open ground.

fields.name: kind
fields.note: Which mark it is. Three of the seven have been seen on the wire and the rest are recorded from what a client is able to send.
